A runs at 8 km/h and B at 6 km/h. B has a 10-minute head start. A overtakes B after (in minutes)
questions.explanation: B is 6 × (10/60) = 1 km ahead. Closing speed = 2 km/h. Time = 1/2 h = 30 minutes.

questions.question: Two runners start together on a 400 m circular track at 5 m/s and 7 m/s in the same direction. They first meet after (seconds)
Two runners start together on a 360 m circular track at 5 m/s and 7 m/s in opposite directions. They first meet after (seconds)
Two men start from two places 60 km apart towards each other at 4 km/h and 6 km/h. The distance from the first man's start where they meet is
questions.explanation: Time = 60 ÷ 10 = 6 h. The first man walks 4 × 6 = 24 km.

questions.question: The speeds of A and B are in the ratio 3 : 2 and they approach each other from two points 100 km apart. A covers up to the meeting point
questions.explanation: They meet at distances in the ratio 3 : 2. A covers 100 × 3/5 = 60 km.

questions.question: A thief is 200 m ahead of a policeman. The thief runs at 10 km/h and the policeman at 11 km/h. The distance run by the thief before he is caught is (km)
questions.explanation: Closing speed = 1 km/h. Time = 0.2 h. Thief runs 10 × 0.2 = 2 km.

questions.question: Two runners start together on a 400 m circular track at 3 m/s and 5 m/s in the same direction. When they first meet, the faster runner has run (metres)
questions.explanation: Relative speed = 2 m/s. Time = 200 s. The faster runs 5 × 200 = 1000 m.

questions.question: A car leaves X for Y at 60 km/h. One hour later another car leaves Y for X at 40 km/h. XY = 300 km. They meet at a distance from X of (km)
questions.explanation: In 1 h the first covers 60 km. Remaining 240 km closes at 100 km/h in 2.4 h. The first car travels 60 × 3.4 = 204 km.

questions.question: In a 1,000 m race A beats B by 100 m. If A runs at 10 m/s, B runs at (m/s)
questions.explanation: A finishes in 100 s. B covers 900 m in that time: 9 m/s.

questions.question: In a 100 m race, A beats B by 10 m and B beats C by 10 m. A beats C by (metres)
questions.explanation: When A runs 100, B runs 90. When B runs 100, C runs 90, so when B runs 90, C runs 81. A beats C by 19 m.

questions.question: Two trains start from two stations 450 km apart towards each other at speeds in the ratio 4 : 5. The faster covers before they meet (km)
Two cyclists start from A and B, 20 km apart, towards each other at 12 and 8 km/h. A fly at 40 km/h flies between them until they meet. The distance flown is (km)
questions.explanation: Time to meet = 20 ÷ 20 = 1 h. Distance flown = 40 × 1 = 40 km.
